name: Apollo 12 LM
about: Apollo 12 LM (1969-099C), a crewed vehicle (LM AS), launched 1969 Nov 14. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DSO).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1969 Nov 14), held fixed
